# Capacity summary

<!-- Generated by tools/capacity_calc.py. Do not edit by hand; edit the inputs and rerun. -->

Purpose: one table per scenario showing, for each role and month, the demand hours, the effective capacity hours, the capacity gap (demand minus supply; positive means more work than capacity), and the load ratio. Use it to see where demand is greater than supply before a monthly review.

Reading the table: a gap of 0 or less means the planned work fits. `undefined_no_capacity` means the role has demand or a slot but zero effective hours, so no ratio is calculated.
